children: Glucotrack entered into an amendment to its Common Warrants issued in the August 4, 2026 private placement. The change prevents any warrant exercises or related share issuances until stockholders approve the full issuance under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(d) and other applicable Nasdaq rules. The amendment aligns the financing structure with exchange compliance requirements and defers potential dilution until after a shareholder vote.

: Align with Nasdaq shareholder approval requirements
